test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

Recovering from an illness or medical treatment.
solution:
The most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words "Recovering from an illness or medical treatment" is "Convalescent".

Explanation:

Bohemian: A person who is socially unconventional and often involved in the arts.

Connoisseur: A person who is an expert in a particular area, especially in matters of art or taste.

Convalescent: A person who is recovering from an illness or medical treatment.

Cosmopolitan: A person who is familiar with and at ease in many different countries and cultures.

Hinglish Solutions:

दिए गए समूह के शब्दों के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त एक शब्दीय विस्तार "बीमारी या चिकित्सा से स्वस्थ होना" के लिए "Convalescent" है।
